blurb:
Unlike any other tour! 
Scaring brave souls since 2007.
The Ultimate ghost hunters experience with you in mind, the Real Ghost Hunter! The only ghost tour in town offering a fully interactive Paranormal Ghost hunting tour beginning to end. First spooky haunted history, then a brief interactive ghost hunting tools session, but If you are an experienced Ghost hunter, you can jump right into the demo. Then real ghost hunting in Haunted places! Untimely deaths and murder mysteries lead to unlimited ghost sightings, tingling on the back of your neck, and hot&cold spots. If you catch a ghost you may be asked to join The Paranormal Group. Most tour times for all ages. Free souvenir photos included. Haunted dinner option available before tour. Specialized ghost hunting equipment provided for ghost catching and signature phone apps for taking home paranormal evidence. This is a walking tour. Please note: Departure location may change to enhance tour and for safety, avoid events, or weather.
